entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number please?

Thank you, Jane. Let me pull that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 27th. To process this correctly, can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just... hard to use. Honestly, the whole menu system is confusing. I read the user manual, and I still can't get it to do what I want. I just expected more from the interface.
I understand. It can be frustrating when a new device doesn't feel intuitive. Please hold for one moment while I check the return eligibility for you.
Thanks for your patience, Jane. I've just reviewed your order against our policy. It looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return window.
Okay. So you can process the return?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated that for you. I'm emailing a prepaid shipping label to the address on file now. You should receive it within the next 5 minutes. Just print that out and attach it to the original box.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
